text_block_list.text:
When I visited Tokai Teio's classroom
to let her know about the change in training location—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you are...?
Teio-san, you have a guest.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey Trainer!
choice_data_list: Why are you wearing your racing outfit?
Why are you wearing your racing outfit?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to train in my racewear today
so it feels like a real race!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"You dashed out of the classroom the second class ended,
the teacher was so surprised..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And your reason is "My racing outfit is calling to me!" after all♪
You really do love that outfit, don't you~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I mean—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
I did it, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm finally getting
my very own racewear!!
choice_data_list: I gotta start thinking up the design right away.
I need to start thinking up the design right away.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I want to put in
a matching motif with the President!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what would be good~? Since we're doing this,
I want to put all my passion into the design!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Nice, nice!
It looks like it'd give off some real dignity, just like the Prez!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez is always cool, but when she puts on
her racing silks, she's like, a million times cooler~

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
While she was waving in the winner's circle,
her tie fluttering in the wind looked so cool—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She totally felt like an "Emperor"!
I really looked up to her and wanted to be just like that!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And the design is complete♪
Ah, I can't wait to run in my racing outfit~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And the result is this Racewear!
It's got plenty of dignity, right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "This racing attire is a sign of my vow to become just like the Prez back then!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... If you wish to project dignity,
please compose yourself a bit more."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You are a young lady of an old, noble family, after all. For your family's sake, you must learn modesty.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, don't talk like an old gramps!
I'm going to build up my own dignity in my own way!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Even today, after working hard in training—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Found you, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Clean up the games and snacks you left scattered all over the student council room.
Post-haste, at once!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'll do it later! I decided this morning that I'd
run in my racing silks just like the President—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good for you. You can run around as much as you want while cleaning.
On top of that, the President will be watching over you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!?
I'm not happy about that at all~!

Before I could even explain myself,
Tokai Teio was dragged off
by Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It seems there are still many hardships ahead
before you can become a majestic Teio-san...

All in all,
it seems the racing outfit is having a good influence
on Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice cape!
I'd love it if the pattern on the sleeves matched too♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: The color's gotta be the same red as the Prez, no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And the design is complete♪
Ah, I can't wait to run in my racing outfit~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And the result is this very Racewear!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Capes are seriously cool, aren't they?
Maybe I oughta try running with one on next time~

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You really get influenced so easily, don't you...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What was thaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now, now.
You can't really blame Vodka for looking up to them!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Her cape fluttering behind her,
the Prez tore across the turf like a gale...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
My heart was stolen the moment I laid eyes on it,
and it kept pounding for the longest time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "This racing attire is a symbol of my vow to become just like that myself!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Stealing all the attention and delivering a race
that makes everyone's hearts pound—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Before aiming for that, how about cleaning up
the games and snacks you left scattered all over the student council room?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Geh! Air Groove?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just as you wish, until the cleaning is done,
I shall allow you to monopolize my gaze.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I-I don't want that at allllll~~~~~!!

Before I could even explain myself,
Tokai Teio was dragged off
by Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, I can't take my eyes off her, but in a different sense.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haha, ain't that the truth!

All in all,
it seems the racing outfit is having a good influence
on Tokai Teio.
